text:
liz: Heads up — releasebot queued v1.12.3 but the PR that merged was docs-only. Should stable get a patch bump? @omar
omar: historically we always bumped patch on stable. docs-only used to be buildmeta-only but people expect numeric bumps for telemetry.
deploy-bot: releasebot: queued v1.12.3+build.789 -> stable (canary start)
sam: playbook: canary failures auto-rollback to previous tag.
maggie: if we skip patch, our changelog generator ignores the release unless we wire buildmeta into it; it currently checks semver increments only.
kevin: proposal: introduce a "docs-only" label that makes releasebot publish buildmeta-only tag (v1.12.2+docs.1) and avoid bumping patch. Only bump patch for code/api changes.
omar: risk: teams pinning major.minor.patch will not see buildmeta updates — intended for tiny docs fixes but could surprise some internal consumers.
liz: enterprise customers sometimes expect every public release to increment patch. I'm ok with docs staying buildmeta-only if we communicate behavior clearly.
maggie: we can modify changelog tooling to include buildmeta-only entries under a "docs" section so nothing is lost.
deploy-bot: canary report: 3/5 OK, 2/5 FAILED (inference-tests timeouts). Rolling back to v1.12.2 now.
sam: rollback completed; tag v1.12.2-rollback created. Looks like infra flakiness, unrelated to docs PR.
kevin: still in favor of docs-only RFC. This incident shows we need clearer labels + releasebot tests but not policy rollback.
liz: action items: Omar + Kevin draft RFC for "docs-only buildmeta" and releasebot change. Maggie to add changelog inclusion. Sam to add playbook note about rollback tag naming (e.g., vX.Y.Z-rollback-<ts>).
omar: I'll draft RFC this afternoon and link it here. @maggie can you prototype a releasebot flag?
maggie: :thumbsup: will add flag + unit tests so stable honors docs-only label and integration test for release-notes picking up buildmeta.
liz: Thanks — ping when RFC PR is up. If helpful we can do a 15-min sync.
```example
# example tag for docs-only flow
git tag v1.12.2+docs.1 -m "docs-only release"
git push origin v1.12.2+docs.1
```
liz: closing thread for now — will reopen when RFC PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
